thread:
Nora (CS): heads up — OptiGen Labs sent a 85-question security + privacy vendor form and marked it as required for renewal. renewal in ~45 days. can we put together the controls pack and a plain-language cover note? link: https://optigen.example.com/vendor-form/85
Priya (CSM): on it. they've specifically asked about: data residency, fine-tuning policies, embeddings retention, and who the subprocessors are. also asked if we support tenant-specific KMS for hosted plans.
Vik (Security): short answers: Hosted: cloud-managed keys, no tenant BYOK. Dedicated/Private: BYOK via KMS supported. fine-tuning: we do not fine-tune customer data on shared models; we offer isolated fine-tune endpoints for Dedicated/Private under contract.
Omar (Infra): backups: cross-region snapshots for Hosted, retention 90 days default. cold backups may have longer retention as part of archival lifecycle. can we say "snapshots are retained for 90 days, and archival copies may persist until rotated"?
Jules (Legal): prefer wording: "primary data removal completed within 30 days; backups and archival copies are subject to restoration windows and may take additional time to fully expire." we'll review final language before it goes to customer.
Nora (CS): great. Priya — can you offer a 14-day Dedicated trial to unblock them? that might reduce renewal friction. include the estimated price delta in the note.
Priya (CSM): yes. i'll propose 14-day trial w/ predefined SLOs and a telemetry review session. pricing delta: +20% monthly on their current committed usage (approx) — i'll include exact numbers after ops confirms.
Vik (Security): i will assemble SOC2 controls mapping and the infosec answers. will also include a short matrix: keys, logs, retention, fine-tune policy, subprocessor list. ETA end of day. evidence-bot: control-mapping v1 uploaded to /customer_evidence/optigen/control-mapping-v1.zip :white_check_mark:
docs-bot (automation): created draft vendor-friendly FAQs at /docs/vendor_faqs/optigen-faq.md
Omar (Infra): embeddings: default retention 90 days for Hosted; Dedicated/Private configurable. note: embeddings stored encrypted at rest; we do not expose raw embeddings to third-party subprocessors.
Nora (CS): include a plain-language snippet for their vendor manager explaining "why Dedicated enables BYOK" and what tradeoffs are. Priya will add pricing and trial mechanics.
Priya (CSM): drafting 1-page cover note now. will call out: 1) SOC2 report (available under NDA) 2) BYOK availability and what it means 3) embeddings retention and deletion workflow 4) proposed 14-day Dedicated trial + cost delta 5) list of public subprocessors (cloud provider, monitoring, CDN).
Vik (Security): uploaded final answers and evidence bundle to /customer_evidence/optigen/final-package.zip. pinging @Nora @Jules. :rocket:
Jules (Legal): i'll do a quick review of the BYOK and deletion wording — aim to get back in 3 hours.
Nora (CS): thanks everyone. once legal thumbs up, i'll send to OptiGen and propose a walkthrough call. keeping this concise should improve renewal signal.
Priya (CSM): noted — i'll prep calendar options for a customer call next week and include the 14-day trial terms in the packet.
Nora (CS): perfect. closing loop: drop the final PDF + evidence in /customer_evidence/optigen/ and DM me when uploaded.
Vik (Security): done — package uploaded and dm sent.
Nora (CS): received. sending to OptiGen now. thanks team!"
